description: Conservative non-headline title rules, applied to title after strip+NFC. Each hit rejects the record from clean (raw is kept) and is logged in issues.csv/rejected.csv. match=exact compares the whole title; match=regex uses re.match (anchored at the title start). source=null applies to every source. match=missing_sapo is a source policy: records of that source with no sapo are rejected (issue missing_sapo_policy). Only add a rule after checking its hits on real data.

rules.reason: group decision 2026-10-23: Eva records without a visible sapo (mostly photo-gallery pages) are excluded so every Eva record has title + sapo
generic page title 'Tin tức', not a headline

rules.reason: print-edition index page, not an article

rules.reason: daily print-edition digest, not a headline
